instruction: Navigate to the travel destinations section to discover United's destinations.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United Airlines homepage to the destinations/travel page. Similar complexity to original baggage calculator task - single navigation within united.com. Uses regex pattern to match destination-related URLs. Uses existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric.

Getter 'active_tab_info' can successfully extract the active tab URL from Chrome
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly uses regex pattern matching to verify URL contains 'destination' in the path
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly (as expected with type='rule') and accesses rules['expected']
Regex pattern 'united.com/en/us/.*destination' is semantically appropriate - matches destination-related URLs while being flexible for variations in URL structure
Complete coverage: instruction only requires navigating to destinations page, and evaluator checks exactly that via URL pattern
No postconfig needed - verification only requires checking final URL state
Logic will work correctly at runtime - getter extracts URL, metric performs regex matching, expected pattern matches actual United.com destination URLs
